notes.headline: Fabrikam opens an R&D hub in Lyon for 300 hybrid engineers
notes.summary: Fabrikam Industries has announced a new R&D hub in Lyon, opening in November 2026, with 300 engineers working in a hybrid model.
notes.meetingPrompt: Raise the VPN capacity plan for the Lyon hub at the service review, without presenting the announcement as the cause of the breach.

notes.headline: Litware launches a self-service HR portal for its employees
notes.summary: Litware Insurance has rolled out a new self-service HR portal to all employees from 14 September 2026.
notes.meetingPrompt: The launch explains the surge of access requests. Propose a knowledge article and an automated access workflow in the remediation plan.
